summary: Menu khong con bi che hay cat: menu ..., menu chuot phai va lich chon ngay luon noi tren cung, nam gon trong man hinh; them menu chuot phai tren video va trong trinh soan thao; sua loi mat noi dung kich ban.
changes: Menu ... tren the video (truoc bi thumbnail cat mat muc Xoa), menu kieu doan va menu ... trong trinh soan kich ban, menu Mau nhanh cua phac thao: hien day du, tu lat len khi het cho, Esc va bam ra ngoai deu dong.

Chuot phai: tren the video/dong video, the du an, Final cho duyet, khung video (phat, ghi chu/phac thao tai khung nay, lui/tien 1 frame, copy link/timecode, safe area, tai ban goc), ghi chu, doi tuong phac thao (nhan ban, thu tu lop, xoa) va vung trong (dan, chen anh, mau).
Kich ban: mo lai kich ban vua soan khong con hien trang trang roi ghi de len ban tren may chu; dang luu ma go tiep tieu de khong bi tra ve.
Proxy HLS: segment dung 4/6 giay theo cai dat (truoc ~10 giay vi keyframe khong duoc ep), tua muot hon.
Dien thoai: man hinh review xep doc, khung video khong con bi bang ghi chu che mat.
Hop thoai Du an moi / Doi ten va o tim kiem Ctrl/Cmd K tu dat con tro; Enter khi bo go tieng Viet dang ghep chu khong gui ghi chu nua; chuot phai len filmstrip khong con keo theo tua video.
